name: What is the process for designing a custom sanctuary bathroom with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for designing a custom sanctuary bathroom with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our design-build process begins with an in-depth consultation to understand your vision, needs, and aesthetic preferences. Following this, we develop CAD-supported layouts and material selection boards, refining the design until it perfectly aligns with your expectations. Once the design is finalized, our experienced team manages all aspects of construction, from permitting coordination to final installation. This integrated approach provides a single point of coordination, simplifying a complex renovation for the homeowner.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves an initial consultation, CAD-supported design, material selection, and full construction management, offering a single point of coordination from concept to completion.
